text: How has response time trended since 2018?

args.query: SELECT CalYear, AVG(FirstPumpArriving_AttendanceTime) AS avg_attendance_seconds FROM incidents WHERE CalYear >= 2018 GROUP BY CalYear ORDER BY CalYear;

text: From 2018 to 2026 the average first-pump attendance time rose from ~314 s to ~330 s, a ~5% increase. After a dip to ~301 s in 2020 (likely pandemic-related), the trend has been upward each year, reaching ~330 s in 2026.
